sentences.text: Sir Lucian Grainge serves as Chairman and CEO of Universal Music Group, having spent his entire career in the music industry.

Over four decades he has signed and worked with many global stars, including ABBA, Jay Z, Elton John, Katy Perry, Queen, Rihanna, The Rolling Stones, Sam Smith, U2 and Amy Winehouse, pioneering new approaches to signing and developing the world's most successful recording artists and songwriters.

sentences.quote: He also consistently champions the development of innovative business models and partnerships with a wide range of technology and media partners around the world.

sentences.text: In October 2026 UMG promoted Frank Briegmann to Chairman and CEO of Universal Music Europe, Australia, New Zealand, Canada and Deutsche Grammophon, still reporting to Sir Lucian Grainge.

Libby Bush of CAA joins in November in the new role of President, Global Brands and Commercial Partnerships, reporting to COO Boyd Muir, and Oscar Celma became SVP, Applied AI and Machine Learning in September, reporting to Chief Data Officer Hannah Poferl.

Grainge's January 2026 staff message set priorities on AI, superfan premium tiers and independent-label partnerships including the Downtown deal; after Pershing Square's April bid UMG restated confidence in his leadership.
